references.text: The Israelites complained and said they would rather die in the wilderness. God answers here that he will do exactly what they said.
God confirms that he will do to them as he has said, and that this entire wicked community will perish in the wilderness.
God's oath 'As I live' (חַי־אָנִי) is also used in Ezekiel to confirm his judgment.
The expression 'As I live, says the Lord' (חַי־אָנִי נְאֻם־יְהוָה) is used as a solemn oath formula.
The same oath formula 'As I live, says the Lord' is used to confirm God's judgment.
God swears by his own life (חַי־אָנִי) when he gives a solemn promise.
The Lord swore in his anger that that generation would not see the land, fulfilling their own words.
The book of Hebrews refers to this event where God swore that those who were disobedient would not enter into his rest.
